ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time (price list). Conference room rates are for 4, 8 and 12 hours; consult separately for use outside business hours. Advance receipt of packages is only for the day before the event, and packages cannot be accepted on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Submit an advance load-in notice at least 1 week before the usage date (packages cannot be accepted if it is not submitted). The guideline for the number of boxes accepted is 2 boxes (cardboard-box equivalent) per room; cash and other valuables, PCs containing personal information data and the like cannot be accepted, and no responsibility is taken for loss or damage. (Source: Price list updated July 13, 2026; Advance Load-in Notice (stored packages); Document download page)
ops.loadingHours: If there is load-in/load-out, submit an "Advance Load-in Notice" or a "Load-in/Load-out Schedule" at least 1 week before the planned usage date. Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave from the designated place within the usage time, and the venue may adjust load-in times and the like. The loading area in the equipment list is "B3F", and loading and unloading is limited to 30 minutes (the facility details in the Terms of Use give the loading area floor as "B1"). For the 2F and 3F, use the load-in elevator (entrance door 1,200 mm wide x 2,500 mm high; inside the car 1,750 mm wide x 2,150 mm deep x 2,700 mm high; load capacity 1,800 kg). The reception point is the Service Center on the 1F of Sumitomo Fudosan Tokyo Mita Garden Tower. The 1F entrance is open 7:00-22:00. (Source: 2F/3F Conference Room Equipment List updated September 11, 2026, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 16 and 21)
ops.vehicleRules: The vehicle limit in the equipment list is 3,200 mm high x 6,400 mm long, 2.0 t. Bellesalle-exclusive parking and a vehicle drop-off area are "none". Products, packing materials, decoration materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. If delivery vehicle traffic is expected to be congested, traffic staff are placed at the entrance and so on. Parking a car on the road around the building (public open space / on the premises) is grounds for cancellation of the usage contract or suspension of use. (Source: 2F/3F Conference Room Equipment List updated September 11, 2026, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 9, 15 and 16)
ops.parking: In the parking column of the equipment list, hourly parking is "available" (300 yen per 15 minutes, no maximum charge), and Bellesalle-exclusive parking and a vehicle drop-off area are "none". The official materials do not state the number of spaces or size limits. To find nearby hourly parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Mita Garden" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation), which is linked from the official facility page. (Source: 2F/3F Conference Room Equipment List updated September 11, 2026, official facility page)
ops.catering: Outside food/drink brought in is allowed. However, if a caterer other than the operator's designated vendors is used, an "outside food/drink fee" applies (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). Party menus for receptions are introduced on the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide PDF, FAQ, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 4)
